description: Register of retest/action triggers — conditions that activate deferred or blocked work items

triggers.name: FormImporter NuGet Version Advance
triggers.action: Run formimporter_watch.py --run-repro; if PASS move FormImporter to candidate generation lane

triggers.name: Live PR Creation Approval
triggers.action: Create README I/O PRs for all 6 families (42 examples + 6 root READMEs + Words version bump 26.4.0→26.5.0)

triggers.name: Merge PR Approval
triggers.action: Merge all README I/O PRs; perform post-merge verification

triggers.name: Remote Repo Drift Detected
triggers.condition: remote-example-inventory.json hash mismatch vs sprint75 baseline on next remote refresh
triggers.action: Run full remote truth reconciliation; classify drift and update publication truth matrix

triggers.name: Aspose.Words NuGet Advance (beyond 26.5.0)
triggers.action: Update handoff packages to new version; regenerate Words examples; verify at new version
triggers.taskcard: TC-SPRINT75-ITEM3 (new version would replace drift resolution)
